correctness.rationale: On Q=Z/kZ x {0,1}, hidden a toggles lanes; b swaps pair indices 0,1; c:i->-i; d:i->1-i; visible e swaps (0,0) and (1,0). Each map squares to identity. The visible c,d product rotates indices, with b conjugates generating S_k on hidden pairs. Nonempty pair unions are closed under hidden epsilon closure; conjugating the e split adds an arbitrary missing pair to any nonempty subset, inductively reaching all 2^k-1 subsets. A pair permutation sends a symmetric-difference index to the unique accepting pair 0, distinguishing any two; the original transition group is transitive and singleton final ensures its 2k states minimal. Both {P0} and {P1} map via e to {P0,P1}, so projected minimal transition not injective, hence non-permutation. Independent BFS of closures confirmed all subsets for k=2..8 (finite corroboration). The 2^k-1 upper bound holds for any permutation automaton with this erased matching.

originality.rationale: Hoffmann 2021 establishes the numerical hidden-orbit upper bound and a seven-letter lower-bound construction on a parameter regime 0<2m+1<n, excluding full hidden matching. Those facts are prior. Here the construction attains full-matching endpoint using only five involutive letters and a minimal input, not implied by arbitrary permutation witnesses; his Remark 1 asks whether seven letters can be reduced. Kutrib et al DUFA operations do not give this erasure witness. Residual possible unindexed all-involution endpoint construction.
residual_risks: Another equivalent five-involution construction might be unpublished or unindexed.
No claim of alphabet size minimality, odd input sizes or general projection upper-bound improvement.

value.rationale: Exponential deterministic blowup under erasure is a canonical automata complexity question. An explicit all-even-size extremal witness with a constant five-letter involution alphabet and fixed-point-free hidden matching is a motivated sharp boundary, not a tiny improvement or generic finite example; nonclosure of undirected class is an additional structural consequence.

final_claim: For every k>=2 there is a minimal 2k-state DUFA with five involutive letters, one erased fixed-point-free involution and one final state, whose projected language has exactly 2^k-1 minimal DFA states; projected language is not DUFA/permutation-recognizable.
limitations: Even 2k input states k>=2, single erased matching involution; no smaller-alphabet optimality or multi-erasure theorem.
Another equivalent five-involution construction might be unpublished or unindexed.
No claim of alphabet size minimality, odd input sizes or general projection upper-bound improvement.
